name: number-field
title: Number Field
description: A number input with decrement and increment buttons.

files.content:
---
import type { ComponentProps } from "astro/types"
import MinusIcon from "@lucide/astro/icons/minus"

import { InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton } from "@/components/ui/input-group"

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof InputGroupButton>

const {
  "aria-label": ariaLabel = "Decrease",
  size = "icon-xs",
  ...props
} = Astro.props
---

<InputGroupAddon align="inline-start">
  <InputGroupButton
    data-slot="number-field-decrement"
    size={size}
    aria-label={ariaLabel}
    {...props}
  >
    <slot>
      <MinusIcon aria-hidden="true" />
    </slot>
  </InputGroupButton>
</InputGroupAddon>

---
import type { ComponentProps } from "astro/types"
import PlusIcon from "@lucide/astro/icons/plus"

import { InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton } from "@/components/ui/input-group"

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof InputGroupButton>

const {
  "aria-label": ariaLabel = "Increase",
  size = "icon-xs",
  ...props
} = Astro.props
---

<InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
  <InputGroupButton
    data-slot="number-field-increment"
    size={size}
    aria-label={ariaLabel}
    {...props}
  >
    <slot>
      <PlusIcon aria-hidden="true" />
    </slot>
  </InputGroupButton>
</InputGroupAddon>

---
import type { ComponentProps } from "astro/types"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { InputGroupInput } from "@/components/ui/input-group"

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof InputGroupInput>

const { class: className, inputmode = "numeric", ...props } = Astro.props
---

<InputGroupInput
  data-slot="number-field-input"
  type="number"
  inputmode={inputmode}
  class={cn(
    "text-center tabular-nums [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none",
    className
  )}
  {...props}
/>

export { default as NumberField } from "./number-field.astro"
export { default as NumberFieldDecrement } from "./number-field-decrement.astro"
export { default as NumberFieldInput } from "./number-field-input.astro"
export { default as NumberFieldIncrement } from "./number-field-increment.astro"
